source.universe: catalog symbols after policy denylist and TON exclusion; NOT an account-verified universe

batch.ordering: host score orders retrieval only; the model selects the symbol or WAIT

forecast.target_return_fraction: policy checkpoint only; not a terminal forecast

outcome.price: close of the 1-minute candle ending exactly at cutoff+horizon
outcome.missing_rule: MISSING_OUTCOME; no interpolation, no last-price fallback

scoring.baseline: zero point forecast plus development-only empirical q10..q90; BLOCKED when development sample is absent

limits: single forecast run; N=1 is diagnostic, not calibration or a superiority claim
catalog universe is current, not historical, so replaying past winners is not causal market selection
absolute timestamps are visible to the model; historical memory cannot be ruled out
no live order or account write occurred
